content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 13.6.1 selects Delaware law, which meets our fallback governing-law element. But the Agreement names no court forum — Section 13.6 is captioned "Jurisdiction" yet contains only a service clause referring to "any such court," and Section 13.7.1 allows either Party to elect binding arbitration under a Schedule 13.7.3 whose seat and rules are redacted. That fails the fallback forum element, so I flagged a deviation and proposed one surgical replacement in 13.7.1 routing unresolved Disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Delaware state and federal courts, leaving the escalation step, the IP carve-out (13.7.2) and interim-relief carve-out (13.7.5) intact.
